statement: OpenCode's pinned retry policy classifies provider and HTTP failures, honors retry-after metadata when available, applies bounded exponential delay, and excludes context-overflow and other non-retryable failures from automatic replay.

display_text.zh-CN: 固定版本的 OpenCode retry policy 会分类 provider 与 HTTP failure，在可用时遵守 retry-after metadata，应用有限的指数延迟，并把 context overflow 等不可重试失败排除在自动重放之外。
display_text.en: OpenCode's pinned retry policy classifies provider and HTTP failures, honors retry-after metadata, applies bounded exponential delay, and excludes non-retryable failures such as context overflow.

evidence.title: OpenCode session retry policy
evidence.locator: retryable, retry-after parsing, and schedule construction

notes: The source defines control flow; no live provider fault was injected.
